3.name: Bladesong
3.notes:
Bonus Action to activate. Requires no armor or shield.
Duration: 1 minute. Ends early if you are Incapacitated, wear armor/shield, or make a two-handed weapon attack.
Uses: Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Regain all uses on Long Rest; regain 1 use when using Arcane Recovery.

Benefits while active:
• Agility: +INT modifier to AC (minimum +1), +10 ft. Speed, Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
• Bladework: Use Intelligence modifier for attack and damage rolls with proficient weapons.
• Focus: Add Intelligence modifier to Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.

3.name: Training in War and Song
3.notes:
Gain proficiency with all Melee Martial weapons that are not Two-Handed and not Heavy.
You can use a proficient Melee weapon as a Spellcasting Focus.
Gain proficiency in one skill: Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance, or Persuasion.

6.name: Extra Attack
6.notes:
When you take the Attack action, you may attack twice.
You may replace one of the attacks with a Wizard cantrip that has a casting time of 1 action.

10.name: Song of Defense
10.notes: While Bladesong is active, when you take damage, you may use a Reaction to expend a spell slot and reduce the damage taken by 5 × the slot level.

14.name: Song of Victory
14.notes: After casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action, you may make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
